overview.title: What is Network School?
overview.text: Network School is a residential startup society in Forest City, Malaysia, where builders live and work together to learn, earn, get fit, and grow.

overview.title: Who joins Network School?
overview.text: Members come from 50+ countries - including founders, engineers, designers, investors, writers, and creators who share a belief in technology and open networks. The community draws professionals who work remotely and want to build something meaningful alongside like-minded people, without a fixed-term degree or corporate structure. Past cohorts have included builders from the Middle East, India, East Asia, Europe, and the Americas.

history.text:
Network School grew out of [Balaji Srinivasan's writing on network states](https://balajis.com/p/network-school) - the idea that a startup society can form online and then acquire physical presence. In 2024, Balaji chose Forest City, Johor, as the site for the first campus: a largely undeveloped island near Singapore with affordable space and strong connectivity to Asia's tech hubs.

The first cohort ran from September 23 to December 23, 2024, a 90-day program that drew around 128 members from across the globe. That initial run tested the Learn, Burn, Earn, Fun model in a live residential setting and validated demand for something longer. [Network School v2](https://balajis.com/p/network-school-2025) launched March 1, 2025, with double the capacity at 256 members and a full year-long program.

By late 2025, cohorts had grown to 270+ members at peak, with programs like [Ethereum NS](https://www.ethns.io/) and Solana Superteam using the campus as an operational base. The fellowship program expanded with a $100K funding track for global founders who commit to a full year onsite.

location:
Network School is based at the Marina Forest Hotel in Forest City, Johor, Malaysia - a cluster of artificial islands about 30 minutes from Johor Bahru city center and roughly one hour's drive from Singapore.

Forest City sits within the Singapore-Johor Special Economic Zone, giving members easy cross-border access to Singapore for day trips, errands, and flights. The campus has bay views, a waterfront area, and the quieter atmosphere of a planned new city rather than a dense urban environment.

Nearest airports are Singapore Changi (SIN) and Johor Bahru Senai (JHB), both one to two hours away. Ride-hailing apps like Grab handle local travel, and the campus runs a dedicated round-trip shuttle to Singapore.
duration:
Network School runs on rolling monthly enrollment - new members can join on the 1st of any month. There is no published minimum stay; members typically commit to one to three months and extend from there. The current year-long program opened March 1, 2025.

Fellowship recipients commit to a full year on campus as a condition of the $100K grant. Members who extend their stay for two or more months can upgrade to larger apartment units within Forest City.
pricing: Membership costs $1,500 per month for a shared double room, covering accommodation, three daily meals, 24/7 gym access, all events and workshops, coworking space, and high-speed Wi-Fi. Applying via the [referral link](https://ns.com/wagmit/apply) gives one week free. A private room costs approximately $3,000 per month (rate sourced from mid-2025 — confirm current pricing when you [apply](https://ns.com/wagmit/apply)). Fellowship recipients have their full stay covered as part of the $100K funding package.
amenities: Shared double rooms and private rooms at the Marina Forest Hotel
Three daily meals following a health-focused diet
24/7 gym with personal trainers and coach-led morning sessions
Group workouts and body composition tracking
Coworking spaces and dedicated office pods
Weekly hackathons, workshops, and speaker events
NS Cafe with complimentary coffee and beverages
Campus round-trip shuttle service to Singapore
Sports and fitness tournaments including the NS Cup
fellowship:
The [Network School Fellowship](https://ns.com/fellowship) funds up to 100 global founders with $100,000 each for a one-year onsite residency. Room, board, gym access, food, office space, laundry, and cleaning are all included on top of the cash grant. Fellows are expected to ship meaningful work - a new venture or a major milestone for an existing one - during their year on campus.

The application runs four stages: an online form with a short screening test and references at [ns.com/fellowship/apply](https://ns.com/fellowship/apply); a structured Zoom interview; an in-person proctored exam at the Network School campus; and final acceptance with funded relocation. The committee looks for high integrity, high agency, and either a strong academic track record or demonstrated startup traction. Applications are open to candidates from any country with English language fluency.
longtermer:
Members who stay two months or longer can upgrade from a standard double hotel room to a two-bedroom apartment within Forest City, gaining more space and a more independent living setup. Monthly extensions are available with no fixed long-term commitment required.

Network School v3 is planned as a purpose-built residential campus, with units designed for longer stays and families. Open-sourced blueprints are intended to allow the model to scale to additional campuses globally.

kidFriendly.description: Network School welcomes families, and children have been present in every cohort. The campus sits on a low-traffic island with open outdoor areas and bay views - a practical environment for parents who work remotely alongside family life. Kids can use the gym, join campus sports, and participate in community events and social gatherings. Contact the team via [ns.com](https://ns.com/wagmit/apply) for family room options and current family-specific guidance.

discount.text: Apply via the [Network School](https://ns.com/wagmit/apply) referral link to get one week free.

howToEnter.text: Applications are open year-round at [ns.com/apply](https://ns.com/wagmit/apply). Fill out a short form, select your intended start date, and wait for acceptance. If approved, you complete a second step that includes paying your first month's rent. New cohorts start on the 1st of each month, so the time from application to move-in can be as short as a few weeks. To apply for the fellowship, visit [ns.com/fellowship/apply](https://ns.com/fellowship/apply).

faqs.question: What is the monthly cost at Network School?
faqs.answer: A shared double room costs $1,500 per month. A private room costs approximately $3,000 per month (rate as of mid-2025). Applying via the [referral link](https://ns.com/wagmit/apply) gives a 25% discount, bringing a shared room to $1,125 per month.

faqs.question: What is included in the membership fee?
faqs.answer: The monthly fee covers accommodation, three daily meals, 24/7 gym access with coached sessions, all workshops and events, coworking space, and high-speed Wi-Fi. Flights and personal expenses are not included.

faqs.question: Where exactly is Network School located?
faqs.answer: Network School is at the Marina Forest Hotel in Forest City, Johor, Malaysia - about 30 minutes from Johor Bahru and one hour from Singapore. The campus runs a dedicated shuttle to Singapore, and Grab handles local rides.

faqs.question: How do I apply to Network School?
faqs.answer: Visit [ns.com/apply](https://ns.com/wagmit/apply), fill out a short form, and choose your start date. If accepted, you complete payment to lock in your spot. New members can join on the 1st of any month.

faqs.question: What is the Network School Fellowship?
faqs.answer: The [fellowship](https://ns.com/fellowship) awards $100,000 to up to 100 global founders per cohort for a one-year onsite residency, with room, board, gym, and office space all included. Apply at [ns.com/fellowship/apply](https://ns.com/fellowship/apply).

faqs.question: Can I bring my family or children to Network School?
faqs.answer: Yes - families with children have been part of every cohort, and Network School encourages family participation. Contact the team via [ns.com](https://ns.com/wagmit/apply) to discuss family room options and current guidance.

faqs.question: Is there a minimum stay at Network School?
faqs.answer: There is no published minimum stay. Members typically join for one to three months and extend month by month. Longer-term members can upgrade to a two-bedroom apartment within Forest City.

faqs.question: Do I need a tech or crypto background to join?
faqs.answer: No fixed background is required. Network School draws engineers, founders, writers, artists, fitness trainers, and remote workers. The main thing the community looks for is high agency and a belief in technology and open networks.

faqs.question: What visa do I need to stay at Network School?
faqs.answer: Most nationalities can enter Malaysia on a tourist visa or visa-on-arrival for 30-90 days. Longer stays require extensions or a relevant long-stay visa. Network School recommends checking current Malaysian immigration rules for your specific passport before applying.

faqs.question: Is there a referral or discount available?
faqs.answer: Yes - applying through the [referral link](https://ns.com/wagmit/apply) gives a 25% discount off the standard monthly rate, bringing a shared room to $1,125 per month.

faqs.question: What does Learn, Burn, Earn, Fun mean?
faqs.answer: Learn means weekly talks, hackathons, book clubs, and workshops on technology and startup societies. Burn means daily fitness - gym sessions, group workouts, and sports tournaments. Earn connects members to task-based crypto bounties, career coaching, and investor networks. Fun covers social events, bonfires, and day trips to Singapore.

faqs.question: When can I join Network School?
faqs.answer: New members can join on the 1st of any month. The current year-long program opened March 1, 2025. [Apply at ns.com](https://ns.com/wagmit/apply) to select an upcoming start date.
